app_name: SigFlow Office - Outlook Email Signature & Rotating GIF Manager
app_type: hybrid_fullstack (B2B SaaS Internal Tool & Admin Dashboard)
language_context: French & English Bilingual SaaS Interface (French primary UI terms: Signature Outlook, Image Défilante GIF, Bannière Promo, Mention Légale, Extension Poste)

theme.primary_archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST PRECISION (Corporate Enterprise B2B SaaS)
theme.description: High-density executive command center layout paired with ultra-accurate Outlook HTML email preview canvas. Deep slate background with electric blue precision accents and glassmorphism panel headers.

typography.heading_font: Cabinet Grotesk, Plus Jakarta Sans, sans-serif

heading_rules.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-50
heading_rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
heading_rules.h3: text-lg sm:text-xl font-semibold tracking-normal text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200
heading_rules.overline: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400

layout_and_grid.admin_dashboard: Sidebar nav (w-64) + Fluid top bar + High density grid (grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6) with sticky live signature preview panel (col-span-5)
layout_and_grid.employee_portal: Centered focused layout (max-w-5xl mx-auto py-8 px-4) with 2-column split: Left form inputs (Name, Title, Phone Ext, Direct Line, Department), Right live preview & copy-paste actions
layout_and_grid.bento_grid_mode: MODE B: High Density Grid for analytics, brand asset gallery, GIF slide order management, and employee directory status

animated_gif_composer.description: Visual composer where Admin uploads multiple promo images/logos, adjusts slide speed/transition interval (e.g., 2s, 4s), and generates a hosted animated GIF link or canvas slider for Outlook signature integration.
features: Drag and drop reordering of GIF frames
Image upload dropzone with preview thumbnail

live_signature_preview.description: True-to-life Outlook desktop & Web preview box rendered inside simulated Outlook email message window with Subject line, Sender, Receiver, and body text.
features: Light & Dark mode email background toggle
HTML copy button with instant Sonner toast notification
Download raw .html file option for Outlook Signatures folder

copy_paste_modal_outlook_guide.description: Modal with step-by-step visual guidance in French & English for pasting into Outlook Office 365, Outlook Desktop (Win/Mac) and Web Outlook.
features: Visual step 1-2-3 guide with screenshot highlights

employee_directory_table.description: Shadcn UI table showing employees, their phone extensions, role (Admin/Employee), signature sync status, and direct copy link.

testing_and_data_ids.rule: Every interactive input, button, table cell, tab, and preview area MUST contain a unique data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a dual-role B2B SaaS dashboard UI: Role switch between 'Admin (Gestionnaire Brand)' and 'Employé (Ma Signature)'.

Admin can update global brand assets: Logo, rotating GIF banner slides, promo banner click URL, social media links (LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube), company physical address, legal disclaimer text.
Employee can input personal details: Full Name, Job Title/Poste, Email address, Direct line, Phone Extension (Poste), Department, optional photo avatar.
Provide an interactive Animated GIF generator simulator / live frame player where admins can upload multiple slides, change playback speed, and see real-time GIF preview.

Generate table-based Outlook HTML signature code that works perfectly across Outlook Desktop (Windows / Mac), Web Outlook, and mobile apps. Note: Outlook requires <table> structure with inline CSS for 100% email client compatibility.
Include a 1-click 'Copier dans le presse-papier' button using navigator.clipboard with HTML Blob formatting so users can paste formatted rich text directly into Outlook.
Provide a Toast notification (Sonner) on signature copy.
Add a Modal with step-by-step instructions in French showing how to install signature in Microsoft Outlook.
Ensure all components use data-testid for automated end-to-end testing.
